retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist 1980s-90s hip-hop aesthetic featuring high-contrast photography, neon-lit dance floors, and eclectic, multi-colored typography with jagged borders.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, busy composition centered on a central figure flanked by others, set against a neon-lit interior with a glowing tiled floor, all contained within a distinctive jagged white border.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the primary focal point
Neon floor tiles reflecting light onto subjects
Eclectic typography overlapping the top and bottom corners
Jagged, stepped white border framing the entire scene
coreInvariants: Stepped or jagged white outer border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central trio occupying the middle 60% of the frame, full-body view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a red suit and gold chains.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left colorful text, down through the central figures, to the bottom-right blocky text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with subjects, props, and lighting effects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and Purple (accessories and background elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast, typical of neon environments.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Eclectic mix of serif, sans-serif, and script-like forms
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses varied colors and overlapping glyphs
Bottom text uses heavy, blocky sans-serif forms
Sharp, elongated strokes on specific characters like 'A'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated, sharp red 'A' with a thin outline
Overlapping 'C' and 'H' in the top title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast mix of playful decorative type and heavy industrial sans-serif.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a red suit and gold chains flanked by two women in a neon-lit room with a glowing tiled floor, framed by a jagged white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add multi-colored decorative text at the top and a black box with heavy yellow and white sans-serif text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the jagged white border present?
Are the floor tiles glowing in multiple colors?
Is the typography eclectic and multi-colored at the top?
Is the bottom-right text contained in a black block?

adjustableVariables: Color of the neon floor tiles
Specific colors in the top typography
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the jagged white frame.
Ensure the floor tiles have a distinct glow effect.
Verify the top text uses at least three different colors.
Confirm the bottom-right text is bold and blocky.
Ensure the central figure is the primary focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast flash photography of a central subject with a neon-tiled floor, a jagged white border, and eclectic, multi-colored display typography.
